value.title: Keep Quiet and I'll Give It To You
value.synopsis: Ryosuke Kamiya, a third-year college student, is paired up for a presentation with Ruka Someya, a classmate from his seminar whom he secretly finds cute. His joy is short-lived, however, as Ruka—claiming she's too busy with her part-time job—proves to be no help at all, leaving him to prepare for the presentation almost entirely on his own… While working at home, Ryosuke loses his concentration and starts browsing an adult video streaming site, only to be stunned by the sight of a sexy actress who looks exactly like Ruka…?!

value.title: Let Me Stay Here
value.synopsis: Ryosuke tries to apologize again for what happened last night, but Ruka blackmails him with footage she'd secretly taken of him completely naked in his sleep. Her demand was that she be allowed to live in Ryosuke's spacious apartment. An unlikely living arrangement begins between a dull college guy and a sexy gyaru film star! The two start off with the shopping to get ready for their new life together. On the way back, Ruka brings up something that takes Ryosuke a bit by surprise…

value.title: This Really... Turns Me On
value.synopsis: Ryosuke's innocent question about situation-based adult films leads them to explore an old, disused university club building. Ryosuke and Ruka wander through the abandoned clubroom. It's a thrilling situation where they're all alone in a place where no one is likely to come, yet they might just get caught by someone! Ruka looks exasperated at Ryosuke, who can't help but get excited at the thought…

value.title: I'm Doing My Best, Okay?!
value.synopsis: Ruka has gone out for a shoot. Ryosuke understands the logic that filming is just part of the job for an active adult film actress… yet the unease in his heart won't fade. He knows he shouldn't watch, but he can't take his eyes off Ruka in the video, and his unease only grows. When night falls and Ruka returns home after finishing her shoot, Ryosuke—who's been lost in thought all day—is exhausted and gaunt. This has Ruka worried, but unusually for Ryosuke, he initiates sex with her…

value.title: I Love Someya-san
value.synopsis: Having realized his feelings for Ruka, Ryosuke musters his courage and asks her out on a date to the aquarium. Though he still couldn't bring himself to confess his feelings, Ryosuke was able to enjoy the day off with Ruka. On the way home, they stop at a family restaurant, and the conversation eventually turns to Ruka's family. Ryosuke then discovers that her family was connected to the reason she became a sexy actress…

value.title: I Have Something To Show You!
value.synopsis: Winter arrives. Students in recruitment suits become a common sight on campus. Seeing them, Ryosuke, now conscious of the job hunt, asks Ruka if she plans to continue working as a sexy actress, to which she answers… Ruka shows Ryosuke herself in a recruitment suit. Ryosuke puts on his own suit to show her, but unlike Ruka, it doesn't suit him at all. Just as Ryosuke is feeling down, Someya suddenly appears before him as... Section Chief?!

value.title: Are You Sure About It?
value.synopsis: It's Christmas Eve. Ryosuke invites Ruka to a fancy dinner at a hotel he'd splurged on. He makes a small blunder there, but it ends up making him respect Ruka even more. The two go straight to their room, and as they gaze at the beautiful night view, Ryosuke finally confesses his feelings to Ruka! But Ruka feels the urge to tell him something important, all the more so because he is someone so dear to her… What will become of the confession?!

value.title: Let's Stay Together Forever!
value.synopsis: Ryosuke and Ruka are now officially a couple. Ruka had, in fact, also prepared something special for today… And as the seasons turn, spring arrives with cherry blossoms in full bloom. With his final year approaching, Ryosuke is overwhelmed with anxiety about the events ahead, such as his thesis and job hunting. In contrast, Ruka doesn't seem too fazed for some reason… Here's the finale of the story about falling in love with Ms. Someya, a former adult film actress from the same seminar class!
